name: LaunchVibe

sources.title: Homepage — live launch board ('Launch Your Product. Get Featured. Grow Faster'), client-rendered SPA

SubmitMap field report — verified: free email+password account (no OAuth), must upvote 3 products to unlock the form, instant publish, free links are nofollow, $29 Product Sponsor is the only dofollow route

conditions: Free listing requires an email+password account (no Google/GitHub sign-in) AND upvoting at least 3 other products on the homepage before the launch form renders — votes are public under your name
requirements: Accepts SaaS, AI tools, dev tools, open source, side projects — a live product URL is required
Form fields: product name, URL, description, category (13 to pick from), tags (each must be committed as a chip with Enter or it doesn't count)
No review: publishing is instant; no published submission guidelines exist
preparation: A real password — email+password only, no OAuth
Product name, URL, description, category choice, tag list
Be ready to upvote 3 existing products (public, under your account name)
Optionally $29 for Product Sponsor (30 days: sitewide sidebar, above-leaderboard placement, shoutout to their claimed 35k followers, and the only dofollow link)
workflow: Create an account at https://www.launchvibe.app/signup (free, no credit card)
Upvote 3 products on the homepage — this unlocks the submit form
Fill the launch form (name, URL, description, category, tags-as-chips) and publish — it goes live instantly, no review
Listing gets overview/discussion/feedback tabs and sits on the all-time upvote leaderboard (~1,200 launches)
Optional: buy the $29 Product Sponsor slot for 30 days of sitewide placement + the only dofollow link
watchFor: Free listing links are NOFOLLOW (verified: rel=noopener noreferrer nofollow) despite 'quality backlinks' marketing — only the $29 sponsor is dofollow
Ranking is lifetime upvotes with no time window — a new launch competes with all ~1,200 past launches; daily/weekly boards are promised but not shipped
The 3-upvote gate is a traffic scheme, not quality control
Tag list is unmoderated junk (opens with '##', '#.', '#.97') — your product gets filed among that
Tag field quirk: each tag must be committed as a chip with Enter — uncommitted text silently doesn't count
countsAsLive: The launch page is reachable on launchvibe.app with its overview/discussion/feedback tabs and appears on the upvote leaderboard
unknowns: Whether the promised daily/weekly leaderboards shipped after the field report
